Section(s): Appendix A. List of model equations (Kontoravdi et al., 2005)

Text and equations in reading order:
    The intraER MAb balance is
(25) \frac{d[H_{2}L_{2}]_{E R}}{d t}=K_{A}[H_{2}L][L]-K_{E R}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{E R}    [code: ODE, computes [H_2L_2]_{ER}, code proposes balance]
    Similarly, for the Golgi apparatus:
(26) \frac{d[H_{2}L_{2}]_{G}}{d t}=\varepsilon_{1}K_{E R}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{E R}-K_{G}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{G}    [code: ODE, computes [H_2L_2]_{G}, code proposes balance]
    Finally, the rate of MAb production is
(27) \frac{d([{M A}b])}{d t}=(\gamma_{2}-\gamma_{1}\mu)Q_{{M A}b}V X_{\nu}-F_{{o u t}}[{M A}b]    [code: ODE, computes [MAb], code proposes balance]
(28) Q_{M A b}=\varepsilon_{2}\lambda K_{G}[H_{2}L_{2}]_{G}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{MAb}, code proposes constitutive]

Symbols:
  [H_2L_2]_{ER}: Concentration of assembled MAb in the ER. (computed)
  K_{A}: Assembly rate constant. [cell/molecule/h] (parameter)
  [H_2L]: Intra-ER heavy-chain dimer–light-chain assembly intermediate concentration. (computed)
  [L]: Intra-ER light-chain concentration. [molecule/cell] (computed)
  K_{ER}: Rate constant for ER-to-Golgi transport. [h^-1] (parameter)
  [H_2L_2]_{G}: Concentration of assembled MAb in the Golgi apparatus. (computed)
  \varepsilon_{1}: ER glycosylation efficiency factor. [-] (parameter)
  K_{G}: Rate constant for Golgi-to-medium antibody transport. [h^-1] (parameter)
  [MAb]: MAb concentration in the culture medium. (computed)
  \gamma_{2}: Constant for antibody production. [-] (parameter)
  \gamma_{1}: Constant for antibody production. [h] (parameter)
  \mu: Specific cell growth rate. [h^-1] (computed)
  Q_{MAb}: MAb production quantity used in the MAb production rate equation. (computed)
  V: Bioreactor volume. (computed)
  X_{\nu}: Viable cell density. (computed)
  F_{out}: Outlet flow rate. (variable)
  \varepsilon_{2}: Golgi apparatus glycosylation efficiency factor [dimensionless] (parameter)
  \lambda: Multiplicative factor in the equation for the MAb production quantity. (parameter)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  (none recorded)

Laws: 25, 26, 27, 28

laws.description: The intraER assembled MAb balance adds MAb formed from the heavy-chain dimer–light-chain intermediate and light chain, and removes it through ER-to-Golgi transport.
laws.law_type_reason: It is an accumulation of assembled ER MAb with formation and transport-loss terms.

laws.description: The Golgi assembled MAb balance adds the ER-transferred fraction and removes MAb through Golgi-to-medium transport.
laws.law_type_reason: It describes accumulation in the Golgi with an input from the ER and a transport loss.

laws.description: The culture-medium MAb balance adds the production term and removes MAb through the outlet flow.
laws.quote: Finally, the rate of MAb production is
laws.law_type_reason: It gives the accumulation of medium MAb as production minus outlet removal.
laws.issue: The outlet term F_{out}[MAb] lacks the volume normalization required for a concentration balance: F_{out} is an outlet flow rate, so this term has amount/time rather than concentration/time units.

laws.description: The MAb production quantity is calculated as proportional to assembled Golgi MAb concentration, scaled by glycosylation efficiency and a multiplicative factor.
laws.law_type_reason: It is a kinetic expression relating the Golgi MAb concentration to the MAb production quantity.
